sources.title: Mechanics of the Ski–Snow Contact
sources.access: Publisher full text and PDF read.
sources.used: Hard, well-sintered snow impact and delayed elastic response; fitted local K2/cv and dissipation reference.
sources.limits: Not a fresh groomed snow acceptance band, not a 50 C polymer law, not ski friction proof for artificial material.

sources.title: Measurement of mechanical properties of snow for simulation of skiing
sources.access: Publisher PDF read, especially equations 2/3/9 and limitations.
sources.used: Separate static penetration and initial shear failure; dynamic shearing not measured in this work.
sources.limits: Project pair HV .16 and Sf .086 remains illustrative; not a jointly calibrated target condition.

sources.title: Discrete element model for high strain rate deformations of snow
sources.used: Bonded-to-granular transition; calibrated experimental comparisons; model excludes new bond formation.
sources.limits: At -5 C, not a model validation for artificial grains or 60min regeneration.

sources.title: Granular metamaterials with dynamic bond reconfiguration
sources.access: PMC search-indexed sections: design, assembly, discussion and methods. Direct PMC/publisher open failed. Supplementary material not inspected.
sources.used: PLA insertion pins, TPU receiving clips; compression assembly and thermal disassembly.
sources.limits: No verified miniaturized ski-surface, nonthermal reset, 50 C retention or manufacturing cost.

sources.title: 3D self-locking granular metamaterials
sources.access: PMC search-indexed abstract, geometry caption, shear, discussion and methods. Publisher direct open failed; supplementary material not inspected.
sources.used: Large elastic-hook particles, 29mm major body dimension; self-confinement and configuration-dependent sliding-to-locking.
sources.limits: Not submillimetre snow or non-grabbing edge-response validation.

sources.title: Mechanical behaviour of bistable struts
sources.used: Prior art for ideal-hinge von Mises truss and distinction of snap-through/bifurcation. Our equations independently derived.
sources.limits: Not relying on inaccessible full text for numerical values.

sources.title: Dynamics of viscoelastic snap-through
sources.access: Author manuscript PDF, abstract and introductory mechanism/limitations.
sources.used: Pseudo-bistability timing can depend sensitively on parameters and loading history.
sources.limits: No specific recovery time or material performance transferred to S1.
